# sonicray
> Metal GPU path tracing + GPU compositor for light-layer films (Apple Silicon, R + Python). GPL-3. AI-assisted (Claude Sonnet 5.5); inspired by Tyler Morgan-Wall's rayrender/rayshader.

Start here, in this order:
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): briefing for AI assistants: questions to ask the user, settled decisions, pitfalls, commands
- [docs/BRING_YOUR_OWN_DATA.md](docs/BRING_YOUR_OWN_DATA.md): the bundled demo is SYNTHETIC; how to use real sensors
- [docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md): design, measurements, known gaps
- [AI_ATTRIBUTION.md](AI_ATTRIBUTION.md): what AI did and what was verified
Commands: `sr_doctor()`, `sr_demo()`, `sr_intake()` (R); `sonicray doctor|intake|sheet|compose|bench` (CLI at inst/bin/sonicray).
